demonstrated_capital_boundary.before: Opening journal accepted Spot SHORT although closing ownership permits Spot LONG only; direct rejection test failed before repair
demonstrated_capital_boundary.after: Opening request validation rejects Spot SHORT before journal creation and durable submission; fake exchange writes remain zero
demonstrated_capital_boundary.preserved: Spot LONG and Futures LONG/SHORT; valid request serialization unchanged
demonstrated_capital_boundary.historical_invalid_obligation: Existing unsupported UNKNOWN record remains byte-identical and admission-blocking; no deletion, migration, replay or rearm

closing_observation.entry_point: retain_closing_inventory: offline library recovery boundary, not an installed CLI command or live-loop integration
closing_observation.source: Existing retained terminal closing recovery, revalidated against the current parent request, execution scope, exact native fills and stored evidence
closing_observation.transaction: Existing journal write helper owns BEGIN IMMEDIATE and synchronous FULL; no second transaction or separate authority database
closing_observation.instrument_units: Shared explicit BTC/ETH/SOL and USDT/USDC validation; Futures require supplied PERPETUAL, COIN and marginAsset=quoteAsset metadata
closing_observation.metadata_quality: Scope and supplied field identity only; not metadata origin, freshness or current eligibility
closing_observation.spot: SELL base principal and quote proceeds, minus each native commission in its own asset
closing_observation.futures: Signed reduction in derivative quantity and separate native commission deltas; quote notional is never principal cash
closing_observation.reported_futures_pnl: Retained separately with the supplied margin-asset unit; not combined with fees into a posted account-profit figure
closing_observation.fee_fx: No conversion, par valuation or omitted third-asset fees; signed reported rebates remain in their own asset
closing_observation.persistence: Canonical allowed fields in closing_inventory inside the existing intent journal; exact replay is idempotent, conflicting source/schema/movement rejects
closing_observation.authority: No inventory application, account-balance qualification, local-lot PnL qualification, financial qualification or rearm
closing_observation.partial_or_zero_fill: Retains only executed components; never erases the tracked position or resolves the UNKNOWN close

synthetic_controls.futures_long_reduction: 0.002 contracts reduced, 110 quote notional, reported PnL 10, commission 0.11 USDT -> derivative -0.002 and fee delta -0.11 USDT; reported 10 remains separate
synthetic_controls.futures_short_reduction: Derivative +0.002; reported -10 remains separate from fee delta -0.11 USDT
synthetic_controls.native_decimal_context: Thirty-digit fee survives an ambient two-digit Decimal context
